sources.finding: The developer marks a transparent monochrome glyph as tintable; public app objects expose icon_tintable for light/dark client rendering.
Store banner PNGs are 720×320 per platform. Store icon sizes are 80×80 and 144×144 for watchapps. Screenshots retain the exact native display dimensions, without watch outlines.
Existing listing icons, banners and screenshots can be edited in Developer Dashboard separately from a binary release.
The watch launcher menuIcon resource is separate from the Store icon uploads; its platform-specific inversion rules must not be confused with icon_tintable.

implementation: Original code-native SVG glyphs and layouts, deterministic PNG exports; no AI bitmap mockup or copied icon set.
uiVerificationLimit: Unauthenticated Store/Dashboard HTML fetches returned HTTP 403. The exact signed-in checkbox label has not been verified; instructions name the documented icon_tintable setting rather than inventing a UI label.
